params.name: sun_azimuth
params.label: Sun Azimuth
params.description: Which way the sun is, in degrees around the up axis: 0 is toward +Z, 90 toward +X. Both the shaded and the path-traced view are lit from this direction.

params.name: sun_elevation
params.label: Sun Elevation
params.description: How high the sun stands, in degrees above the horizon: 90 is straight overhead, below 0 it lights from underneath.

params.name: sun_intensity
params.label: Sun Intensity
params.description: How bright the sun is in the path-traced view; 0 leaves the sky as the only light. The shaded view takes the sun's direction only.

params.name: sun_color
params.label: Sun Color
params.description: Colour of the sunlight in the path-traced view, as linear values, scaled by Sun Intensity.

params.name: sky_color
params.label: Sky Color
params.description: Colour of the sky straight overhead in the path-traced view, as linear values; it grades into Ground Color toward straight down.

params.name: ground_color
params.label: Ground Color
params.description: Colour of the sky straight down in the path-traced view, as linear values: the light a surface facing the ground receives.

params.name: sky_intensity
params.label: Sky Intensity
params.description: Multiplies Sky Color and Ground Color: how much light the sky itself gives in the path-traced view.
